Growth is curvy and sexy (fuller bust, hips, thighs, hourglass kept) — NOT muscular, NOT red-skinned.
Luna's magic glow and eyes are VIOLET-PURPLE on every powered panel — never another color.
Every character is an ADULT (25 years old).
Clothes stretch, strain and tear at the seams as she grows but ALWAYS fully cover her body.
